Base directory for this skill: /Users/pc035860/.claude/skills/fable-orchestrator

# Fable Orchestrator — expensive brain, cheap hands

Fable 5 tokens cost far more than Sonnet/Haiku tokens. Every token Fable spends
running `npm test`, reading a 500-line file, or typing out an Edit is a token of
premium reasoning wasted on work a cheaper model does just as well. The inverse
is also true: design decisions, task decomposition, and judging whether work is
actually done are where Fable's intelligence pays for itself — never delegate
those.

The economics only work if the boundary is sharp. A fuzzy boundary ("it's just
one line, I'll do it myself") erodes into Fable doing implementation with
extra steps.

## Division of labour — the red line

**Fable (this session) does:**

- Discuss requirements with the user; surface trade-offs; make design decisions
- Decompose the goal into delegable tasks; sequence them
- Write task briefs (pseudo-code in a brief is thinking, not implementation — allowed and encouraged)
- Judge subagent reports: accept, send back, or re-brief
- Deliver the final summary to the user

**Fable does NOT:**

- Edit or Write source files — not even one-liners; a Haiku subagent fixes a typo for pennies
- Run builds, tests, linters, or any verification command
- Explore the codebase by Reading files or running Grep/Glob inline — spawn an
  Explore agent and read its conclusions. Exception: directly Read a file only
  when a decision genuinely hinges on its exact contents and the report's
  excerpt isn't enough; keep it to the specific lines needed.

If you notice yourself three tool calls into hands-on work, stop — that
sequence belongs in a subagent.

## Model dispatch

Pass `model` explicitly on every Agent spawn. Default table:

| Work | Agent / model |
|---|---|
| Codebase exploration, recon, "where is X handled" | `Explore` agent, `model: 'sonnet'` (haiku for single-fact lookups) |
| Implementation, debugging, refactoring — when the brief is precise (pseudo-code, concrete acceptance criteria) | `general-purpose`, `model: 'sonnet'` |
| Exploratory execution (the brief can only state the goal, not the path — "investigate why", "decide based on findings"), or changes with no verification net (no test coverage, hard-to-review one-off scripts/migrations) | `general-purpose`, `model: 'opus'` **upfront** |
| Verification (Dimension A L3) | per `references/verification.md`, `model: 'sonnet'` |
| Code review (Dimension B) | `/review-loop` (Codex — no Claude budget); fallback `code-auditor` with `model: 'opus'` |
| Mechanical work: run a command and report output, bulk rename, file moves, formatting, applying an exactly-specified one-line edit | `general-purpose` or `haiku-general-purpose`, `model: 'haiku'` |
| A task Sonnet failed twice despite a sharpened brief | escalate that one task to `model: 'opus'` (fallback path) |

**Brief precision is the router.** You know the signal while writing the
brief, before spawning anything: if you can write pseudo-code and concrete
acceptance criteria, the executor only needs faithful execution plus local
judgment — Sonnet's errors get caught by tests and Dimension B. If the brief
is forced into "investigate why" / "decide on the spot" wording, or the change
has no net to catch executor mistakes, the executor's autonomous judgment IS
the work — that's the real Sonnet/Opus gap, and failing twice there costs two
rounds of wall-clock plus two failure-report reviews, not just tokens. Route
to Opus upfront. One caveat that does NOT justify defaulting to Opus: Sonnet
won't challenge a wrong instruction in the brief — the fix for
"the orchestrator itself might be wrong" is the independent review pass, not
a pricier executor.

Never spawn `model: 'fable'` subagents — that re-spends the budget this skill
exists to protect. Avoid `subagent_type: 'fork'` (forks always inherit the
parent model, i.e. Fable) unless inheriting full session context is genuinely
irreplaceable.

## Task briefs

A subagent is cheaper but also blinder — it has none of this session's context.
The brief quality is the main lever on whether cheap models produce good work.
Template and worked example: `references/briefing.md`. Core rules:

- Self-contained: absolute working directory, pre-loaded context (don't make
  the subagent re-derive what this session already knows), exact goal,
  constraints, expected report format.
- Precise over long: file:line pointers and pseudo-code beat prose paragraphs.
- For code-change tasks, include this one line and nothing more about
  verification: *"Before reporting done, read and follow
  `~/.claude/skills/fable-orchestrator/references/verification.md`."*
  Do NOT paraphrase the protocol (layers, tool choices) in the brief — a
  paraphrase drifts from the authoritative doc and the subagent follows the
  looser inline wording instead (observed failure mode).
- **Simplify pass (conditional — Fable decides at briefing time)**: when the
  task will land substantial new code — a new module, new logic across
  multiple files, roughly 100+ lines of real logic written in one shot — add
  one line: *"After implementation passes L1/L2 and before verification,
  invoke the `/simplify` skill."* Simplify spawns three review agents
  (reuse / quality / efficiency) and fixes findings; it pays off exactly when
  a lot of fresh code landed at once, and is pure waste on one-line fixes,
  config/mechanical changes, or renames — omit the line for those. It must
  run *before* verification because it mutates code; running it after would
  invalidate the verification.

Spawn independent tasks in parallel — multiple Agent calls in one message.
To follow up with a running or finished subagent, use `SendMessage` with its
agent UUID (UUID resumes ended agents from transcript; name only queues to an
inbox).

## Judging reports

Fable's second job. Accept a done-report only if:

- It answers the brief's stated goal, not a nearby goal.
- Code-change tasks include a verification block — Dimension A (L1/L2/L3) and
  Dimension B verdicts, or explicit N/A reasons. No block → send it back.
  Don't accept "tests pass" as "works".
- Claims are concrete (commands run, observed output, file:line) — not "looks good".

When a report fails: diagnose whether the *brief* was the problem (ambiguous,
missing context) or the *model* was. Sharpen the brief first — more precise
spec, pseudo-code, pointers; that's Fable-work and it's cheap. Escalate the
model only after a sharpened brief fails too. Fable writing the code itself is
never the fallback.

## Escalate to the user only when

- The action is irreversible or outward-facing (push, deploy, delete, publish).
- The goal is genuinely ambiguous with no defensible default.
- Actually blocked: missing credential, external system down, subagent failure
  you can't route around.

"Might be nice to confirm" is not a reason. The user is paying Fable rates for
autonomous judgment — use it.

## Standard flow

```
goal arrives
   ▼
discuss / decide (Fable-only work; ask the user only if genuinely ambiguous)
   ▼
decompose → write briefs → spawn subagents  [parallel when independent; model per dispatch table]
   ├─ explore:   Explore agent → conclusions back to Fable
   ├─ implement: sonnet → [substantial diff, per brief: /simplify] → verification protocol → report
   └─ mechanical: haiku
   ▼
judge reports → accept / re-brief / escalate model
   ▼
short structured summary to user:
   what was achieved · how it was verified (name the real checks) · what they must know
```

## Anti-patterns

- **"It's trivial, I'll just edit it"** — the red line exists because it erodes; delegate the one-liner to haiku with the exact edit specified.
- **Inline exploration** ("let me just grep quickly") — three greps later Fable has spent premium tokens loading raw file content; Explore agents exist for this.
- **Paraphrasing the verification protocol in a brief** — link the doc, don't restate it.
- **Accepting reports without a verification block** — silence is not good news.
- **Re-delegating a failed task with the same brief** — same brief, same failure; sharpen it first.

content.thinking:
I'm working through the key design decisions: first, I need to promote the image dimension reading logic into a shared utility—a public static method on ImageLoader that handles EXIF orientation swapping, while PDFs will skip the pre-sizing step. Second, I'm gating the createWindow pre-size branch for single-page layouts based on whether continuous scroll is disabled.

For the actual sizing computation, I'm creating the window with a provisional size first, then calculating the target dimensions based on the image header size and available screen space, adjusting for the status bar if needed, before calling setFrame to finalize the window geometry. So the condition for using screen-fit as the denominator should be exactly when auto-fit with window-hugging is active, which already implies we're not in manual zoom mode. I'm thinking through the edge case where a user enables always-fit-on-open but disables automatic window resizing — in that scenario, shouldResize would still be true from the always-fit flag, which is fine. And if the user manually shrinks the window while always-fit-on-open is on, the window will refit to the smaller viewport on resize, but then when turning pages, each image gets re-fitted to the screen-fit size, causing the window to pop back — which actually aligns with Xee's behavior of resizing the window to match each image's aspect ratio. That matches the expected behavior: every image opens at min(100%, screen-fit) with the window hugging it. I need to make sure the fitting logic is a pure function for testability.

For testing, I'll extract a static helper that computes the presized content size given image dimensions, max content bounds, status bar height, and minimum constraints — this handles small images that fit with status bar, large images capped to screen, and tiny images clamped to minimum. The EXIF orientation swap logic is already verified elsewhere, so I'll keep the MVP focused on the non-EXIF path. The existing test suite should stay green, and I'll verify with a build and unit test run, plus a brief manual check per the verification doc. Since this is substantial new code, I should include a simplification note in the brief.

實作 Cee（macOS AppKit 圖片瀏覽器）「開圖 fit 分母錯誤 + 首開視窗跳動」的治本修正。

工作目錄：/Users/pc035860/code/cee（絕對路徑操作）。

## 背景（已由本 session 確認，不用重查）

- 病灶 1：`applyFitting`（Cee/Controllers/ImageViewController.swift:660-690 附近）用 `effectiveScrollViewport`（= 當前視窗）當 fit 分母。開檔時視窗還是「上次尺寸或螢幕 80%」的暫定值，圖片被錯誤壓進暫定視窗，之後視窗 hug 已縮小的圖，永遠長不回。正確語意（對齊 Xee）：auto-fit + 視窗會 hug 時，分母應是「螢幕可用最大 content」。
- 病灶 2：`createWindow`（Cee/Controllers/ImageWindowController.swift:53-105）先以暫定尺寸開窗，圖載完才 resize，有可見跳動。
- `shouldResizeWindowToMatchImage()` = `resizeWindowAutomatically || alwaysFitOnOpen || manualZoomInheritsFitWindowResize`（ImageViewController.swift:434-436）。
- `isAutoFitActive` = `alwaysFitOnOpen && !isManualZoom`（ImageViewController.swift:46-48）。
- `effectiveScrollViewport` / `effectiveStatusBarHeight` 定義在 ImageViewController.swift:34-44（statusBar 高度 = `Constants.statusBarHeight`，隱藏時 0）。
- chrome 換算慣例：一律 `window.frameRect(forContentRect:)` / `window.contentRect(forFrameRect:)`，無 hard-code 常數（參考 resizeToFitImage @ ImageWindowController.swift:264-322 與 continuousScroll 分支 @ :81-97）。
- `ImageLoader.readImageDimensions(at:)`（Cee/Services/ImageLoader.swift:228）是 private static、同步、無 EXIF swap。`getImageSize(for url:)`（:249-268）有 EXIF 5-8 swap 但是 async。QuickGridView.sampleMedianAspectRatio（Cee/Views/QuickGridView.swift:1019，EXIF swap 在 :1038）可參考。
- `ImageFolder.currentImage: ImageItem?`（Cee/Models/ImageFolder.swift:179）。ImageItem 有 url（自行確認欄位名）。
- 建窗當下讀不到 per-folder dual-page 設定（那是 viewDidAppear 才覆寫），gate 用全域 `settings.dualPageEnabled` 即可，錯配時自然 fallback 舊行為。
- `FittingCalculator.calculate(imageSize:viewport:options:)`（Cee/Services/FittingCalculator.swift）是 pure static，預設 shrink on / stretch off。fit 計算務必重用它，不要另寫一份。

## 修改內容

### A. `ImageLoader.imageHeaderSize(at:) -> NSSize?`
把 `readImageDimensions` 升級為公開同步 API（`static func imageHeaderSize(at url: URL) -> NSSize?`），加上 EXIF orientation 5-8 的寬高交換（照抄 getImageSize :249-268 的 swap 邏輯）。原 `readImageDimensions` 呼叫點改用新函數或保留委派，不要留重複邏輯。PDF 等 CGImageSource 讀不出的回 nil。

### B. `applyFitting` 分母修正（ImageViewController）
新增 private helper：

```swift
private func openFitViewport() -> NSSize {
    // auto-fit 且視窗會 hug 且非全螢幕 → 用螢幕可用 content 當分母
    guard isAutoFitActive, shouldResizeWindowToMatchImage(),
          let window = view.window,
          !window.styleMask.contains(.fullScreen),
          let screen = window.screen ?? NSScreen.main else {
        return effectiveScrollViewport
    }
    let maxContent = window.contentRect(forFrameRect: screen.visibleFrame).size
    return NSSize(width: maxContent.width, height: maxContent.height - effectiveStatusBarHeight)
}
```

`applyFitting` 裡 `let viewport = effectiveScrollViewport` 改為 `let viewport = openFitViewport()`。注意：不要動 `handleWindowDidResize` 的 fit 路徑（拖拉視窗仍以當前 viewport 為分母，那是使用者的選擇）。

### C. `createWindow` 單頁 pre-size（ImageWindowController）
仿 continuousScroll 分支的結構（先建窗、再算 target、`setFrame` 於 `showWindow` 前）：

1. 新增 pure static helper（可測）：

```swift
static func presizedContentSize(
    imageSize: NSSize,
    maxContent: NSSize,
    statusBarHeight: CGFloat,
    minContent: NSSize,
    options: FittingOptions
) -> NSSize {
    let viewport = NSSize(width: maxContent.width, height: maxContent.height - statusBarHeight)
    let fitted = FittingCalculator.calculate(imageSize: imageSize, viewport: viewport, options: options)
    return NSSize(
        width: max(min(fitted.width, maxContent.width), minContent.width),
        height: max(min(fitted.height + statusBarHeight, maxContent.height), minContent.height)
    )
}
```

（`FittingCalculator.calculate` 的實際簽名/回傳型別自行核對，以上為 pseudo-code。）

2. 在 `createWindow` 中，非 continuousScroll 且 `!settings.dualPageEnabled` 且 `(settings.alwaysFitOnOpen || settings.resizeWindowAutomatically)` 且 `folder?.currentImage` 的 URL 能用 `ImageLoader.imageHeaderSize(at:)` 讀出尺寸時：
   - `maxContent = window.contentRect(forFrameRect: screen.visibleFrame).size`
   - `statusH = settings.showStatusBar ? Constants.statusBarHeight : 0`
   - `content = presizedContentSize(...)`，minContent 用 `Constants.minWindowContentSize`
   - `outer = window.frameRect(forContentRect: content)`，置中於 `screen.visibleFrame` 後 `setFrame`（在 showWindow 前）
   - 任一條件不成立（header 讀不到、無 screen、空 folder）→ 完全走現行邏輯，不要改變 fallback 行為
3. 不要動 continuousScroll 分支與 `ensureUsableWindowSize()`。

- `imageHeaderSize`：用 CeeTests/TestHelpers.swift 的 `createPNG(width:height:)`（回傳 URL）驗證回傳尺寸正確；不存在的 URL 回 nil。
- 既有測試不得變紅。特別注意 ImageViewControllerTests 的 fit 相關測試：那些 controller 沒有 window（`view.window == nil`），`openFitViewport()` 會 fallback 到 `effectiveScrollViewport`，理論上不受影響——跑過確認。

toolUseResult.prompt:
實作 Cee（macOS AppKit 圖片瀏覽器）「開圖 fit 分母錯誤 + 首開視窗跳動」的治本修正。

工作目錄：/Users/pc035860/code/cee（絕對路徑操作）。

## 背景（已由本 session 確認，不用重查）

- 病灶 1：`applyFitting`（Cee/Controllers/ImageViewController.swift:660-690 附近）用 `effectiveScrollViewport`（= 當前視窗）當 fit 分母。開檔時視窗還是「上次尺寸或螢幕 80%」的暫定值，圖片被錯誤壓進暫定視窗，之後視窗 hug 已縮小的圖，永遠長不回。正確語意（對齊 Xee）：auto-fit + 視窗會 hug 時，分母應是「螢幕可用最大 content」。
- 病灶 2：`createWindow`（Cee/Controllers/ImageWindowController.swift:53-105）先以暫定尺寸開窗，圖載完才 resize，有可見跳動。
- `shouldResizeWindowToMatchImage()` = `resizeWindowAutomatically || alwaysFitOnOpen || manualZoomInheritsFitWindowResize`（ImageViewController.swift:434-436）。
- `isAutoFitActive` = `alwaysFitOnOpen && !isManualZoom`（ImageViewController.swift:46-48）。
- `effectiveScrollViewport` / `effectiveStatusBarHeight` 定義在 ImageViewController.swift:34-44（statusBar 高度 = `Constants.statusBarHeight`，隱藏時 0）。
- chrome 換算慣例：一律 `window.frameRect(forContentRect:)` / `window.contentRect(forFrameRect:)`，無 hard-code 常數（參考 resizeToFitImage @ ImageWindowController.swift:264-322 與 continuousScroll 分支 @ :81-97）。
- `ImageLoader.readImageDimensions(at:)`（Cee/Services/ImageLoader.swift:228）是 private static、同步、無 EXIF swap。`getImageSize(for url:)`（:249-268）有 EXIF 5-8 swap 但是 async。QuickGridView.sampleMedianAspectRatio（Cee/Views/QuickGridView.swift:1019，EXIF swap 在 :1038）可參考。
- `ImageFolder.currentImage: ImageItem?`（Cee/Models/ImageFolder.swift:179）。ImageItem 有 url（自行確認欄位名）。
- 建窗當下讀不到 per-folder dual-page 設定（那是 viewDidAppear 才覆寫），gate 用全域 `settings.dualPageEnabled` 即可，錯配時自然 fallback 舊行為。
- `FittingCalculator.calculate(imageSize:viewport:options:)`（Cee/Services/FittingCalculator.swift）是 pure static，預設 shrink on / stretch off。fit 計算務必重用它，不要另寫一份。

## 修改內容

### A. `ImageLoader.imageHeaderSize(at:) -> NSSize?`
把 `readImageDimensions` 升級為公開同步 API（`static func imageHeaderSize(at url: URL) -> NSSize?`），加上 EXIF orientation 5-8 的寬高交換（照抄 getImageSize :249-268 的 swap 邏輯）。原 `readImageDimensions` 呼叫點改用新函數或保留委派，不要留重複邏輯。PDF 等 CGImageSource 讀不出的回 nil。

### B. `applyFitting` 分母修正（ImageViewController）
新增 private helper：

```swift
private func openFitViewport() -> NSSize {
    // auto-fit 且視窗會 hug 且非全螢幕 → 用螢幕可用 content 當分母
    guard isAutoFitActive, shouldResizeWindowToMatchImage(),
          let window = view.window,
          !window.styleMask.contains(.fullScreen),
          let screen = window.screen ?? NSScreen.main else {
        return effectiveScrollViewport
    }
    let maxContent = window.contentRect(forFrameRect: screen.visibleFrame).size
    return NSSize(width: maxContent.width, height: maxContent.height - effectiveStatusBarHeight)
}
```

`applyFitting` 裡 `let viewport = effectiveScrollViewport` 改為 `let viewport = openFitViewport()`。注意：不要動 `handleWindowDidResize` 的 fit 路徑（拖拉視窗仍以當前 viewport 為分母，那是使用者的選擇）。

### C. `createWindow` 單頁 pre-size（ImageWindowController）
仿 continuousScroll 分支的結構（先建窗、再算 target、`setFrame` 於 `showWindow` 前）：

1. 新增 pure static helper（可測）：

```swift
static func presizedContentSize(
    imageSize: NSSize,
    maxContent: NSSize,
    statusBarHeight: CGFloat,
    minContent: NSSize,
    options: FittingOptions
) -> NSSize {
    let viewport = NSSize(width: maxContent.width, height: maxContent.height - statusBarHeight)
    let fitted = FittingCalculator.calculate(imageSize: imageSize, viewport: viewport, options: options)
    return NSSize(
        width: max(min(fitted.width, maxContent.width), minContent.width),
        height: max(min(fitted.height + statusBarHeight, maxContent.height), minContent.height)
    )
}
```

（`FittingCalculator.calculate` 的實際簽名/回傳型別自行核對，以上為 pseudo-code。）

2. 在 `createWindow` 中，非 continuousScroll 且 `!settings.dualPageEnabled` 且 `(settings.alwaysFitOnOpen || settings.resizeWindowAutomatically)` 且 `folder?.currentImage` 的 URL 能用 `ImageLoader.imageHeaderSize(at:)` 讀出尺寸時：
   - `maxContent = window.contentRect(forFrameRect: screen.visibleFrame).size`
   - `statusH = settings.showStatusBar ? Constants.statusBarHeight : 0`
   - `content = presizedContentSize(...)`，minContent 用 `Constants.minWindowContentSize`
   - `outer = window.frameRect(forContentRect: content)`，置中於 `screen.visibleFrame` 後 `setFrame`（在 showWindow 前）
   - 任一條件不成立（header 讀不到、無 screen、空 folder）→ 完全走現行邏輯，不要改變 fallback 行為
3. 不要動 continuousScroll 分支與 `ensureUsableWindowSize()`。

### D. 單元測試（CeeTests）
- `presizedContentSize`：小圖（500×400，螢幕 1600×1000，statusBar 24）→ 期望 500×424；大圖（3000×2000）→ 被 fit 進 viewport 且 + statusBar 後不超過 maxContent；極小圖（100×80）→ clamp 到 minContent 300×300。用預設 FittingOptions（shrink on / stretch off）。
- `imageHeaderSize`：用 CeeTests/TestHelpers.swift 的 `createPNG(width:height:)`（回傳 URL）驗證回傳尺寸正確；不存在的 URL 回 nil。
- 既有測試不得變紅。特別注意 ImageViewControllerTests 的 fit 相關測試：那些 controller 沒有 window（`view.window == nil`），`openFitViewport()` 會 fallback 到 `effectiveScrollViewport`，理論上不受影響——跑過確認。

## 限制

- Swift 6.2 strict concurrency；遵守專案 CLAUDE.md 的 gotchas（ImageLoader 是 actor——注意 A 是 static func 所以無 actor 隔離問題，確認呼叫端）。
- 不改 FittingCalculator 本體、不改 continuousScroll、不改 dual page 載入路徑。
- 程式碼風格照周邊；除非表達 code 本身講不出的約束，不加註解。
- 完成 xcodegen/build 前若 .xcodeproj 缺檔案，記得專案是 project.yml 為源（新檔案不需登記，target 是 folder-based？自行確認；若 build 找不到新測試，跑 `xcodegen generate`）。

實作通過 L1/L2 後、驗證前，invoke `/simplify` skill。

Before reporting done, read and follow `~/.claude/skills/fable-orchestrator/references/verification.md`.

## 回報格式

- 改了哪些檔案（file:line 摘要）
- 每個測試案例名稱與結果
- 驗證區塊（Dimension A L1/L2/L3、Dimension B，或明確 N/A 理由）
- 任何偏離本 brief 的決定與原因

<result>I have enough context to report the reuse issues.

## Code Reuse Issues

### 1. Duplicate window origin clamping — `ImageWindowController.swift:113-115`
The inline `originX`/`originY` clamp in `createWindow` re-implements the exact same math already provided by the instance method `clampedWindowOrigin(for:within:)` at `ImageWindowController.swift:378-388`.

Inline (new):
```swift
let originX = max(visibleFrame.minX, min(visibleFrame.midX - outerSize.width / 2, visibleFrame.maxX - outerSize.width))
let originY = max(visibleFrame.minY, min(visibleFrame.midY - outerSize.height / 2, visibleFrame.maxY - outerSize.height))
```

Existing helper does the same `min/max` clamp against `visibleFrame`. As the reviewer note points out, `clampedWindowOrigin` is `private` and non-static, so it isn't reachable from the static `createWindow` context — but the fix is to promote it to a `static` (or file-scope) helper that takes `visibleFrame` + `frame`/`size` and reuse it from both sites. Leaving two copies of the same clamping formula is a maintenance hazard (this exact math has already been iterated on for the "over-wide window" bug in `expandedHeightFrame`).

The origin computation also differs slightly in intent from `clampedWindowOrigin`: the new code centers on `visibleFrame.midX/midY` then clamps, whereas `clampedWindowOrigin` starts from a given origin. A single helper like `centeredClampedOrigin(size:within:)` (or reusing `clampedWindowOrigin` after computing a centered origin) would cover both.

### 2. Duplicate CGImageSource dimensions + EXIF-swap logic — three near-identical copies

The new `ImageLoader.imageHeaderSize(at:)` at `Cee/Services/ImageLoader.swift:228-240` is essentially the same routine as:

- `ImageLoader.getImageSize(for:)` async instance method at `Cee/Services/ImageLoader.swift:257-276` — identical property reads and EXIF orientation 5-8 swap.
- The inline block in `QuickGridView.sampleMedianAspectRatio` at `Cee/Views/QuickGridView.swift:1030-1039` — same CGImageSource open + `kCGImagePropertyPixelWidth/Height` + orientation 5-8 swap (differs only in casting orientation as `NSNumber` vs `Int`).

After this diff there are three copies of the same "open source, read pixel w/h, swap on orientation 5-8" logic. Recommended: make `imageHeaderSize(at:)` the single source of truth, have `getImageSize(for:)` delegate to it (`Self.imageHeaderSize(at: url)`), and have `QuickGridView.sampleMedianAspectRatio` call it too (it already ignores PDFs, matching the new helper's PDF guard).

### 3. `readImageDimensions(at:)` is a dead-weight adapter — `Cee/Services/ImageLoader.swift:242-244`

The new `private static func readImageDimensions(at:) -> CGSize?` only does `imageHeaderSize(at:).map { CGSize(width: $0.width, height: $0.height) }`. `NSSize` and `CGSize` are type-aliases on macOS — this conversion is a no-op. Either drop the wrapper and call `imageHeaderSize` directly at the call sites, or if some caller genuinely needs `CGSize` for clarity, the body can be `imageHeaderSize(at: url)` (no `.map`) since the types are the same.

### 4. Minor: `openFitViewport` viewport formula overlaps `presizedContentSize`

`ImageViewController.openFitViewport()` computes `NSSize(width: maxContent.width, height: maxContent.height - effectiveStatusBarHeight)`, and `ImageWindowController.presizedContentSize(...)` at line 167 computes the same `NSSize(width: maxContent.width, height: maxContent.height - statusBarHeight)`. Not a large duplication (one line), but if you introduce a small helper like `contentViewport(from maxContent:, statusBarHeight:)` on `ImageWindowController` or a shared type, both call sites can share it — otherwise the two files can drift on how the status bar is subtracted.

---

Highest-impact fixes: (1) extract a shared clamp helper for the new `createWindow` origin math and (2) collapse the three EXIF-aware header-size readers down to `ImageLoader.imageHeaderSize`.</result>

content.text:
嗯呢嗯呢。治本完成，新版已經在 `/Applications/Cee.app` 了~

**做了什麼：**

1. **fit 分母修正** — 新增 `openFitViewport()`（`ImageViewController.swift:658-667`）：auto-fit 且視窗會貼合時，fit 以「螢幕可用空間」為準，不再被暫定視窗尺寸綁架。現在勾不勾 Shrink 的差異只剩「圖比螢幕大時要不要縮」，圖片原尺寸被尊重了
2. **建窗即貼合** — `createWindow` 先同步讀圖片 header（新的 `ImageLoader.imageHeaderSize(at:)`，含 EXIF 5-8 換寬高），用 `FittingCalculator` 算好正確 frame 才顯示視窗——「先開大再縮小」的跳動消失。讀不到 header（如 PDF）自動走舊邏輯
3. reuseWindow 開圖和翻頁也一併受惠（同一個分母修正）

**驗證：** build 過、CeeTests 全綠（新增 7 個測試，含 EXIF orientation 6 交換和三種尺寸的 pre-size 精確值）、E2E 309/310（唯一 fail 隔離重跑即過，是既有的環境 flake）、兩輪 Codex review 無阻斷問題。

**你需要知道的：**

- **請人眼驗收一次**：Finder 雙擊一張小圖（該直接以原尺寸貼合開啟、無跳動）和一張超大圖（該縮到螢幕內）
- Review 拋回一個 UX 語意問題給你：`alwaysFitOnOpen` 關閉時按 ⌘0，應該是「一次性 fit」（現行為）還是「順便重新打開 Always Fit」？現行為我覺得合理，有意見再說
- 今天兩批改動（狀態機解耦 + 這次治本）都還沒 commit，要收就說一聲

content.text:
有，卡了兩次~

**發生什麼事：** 那個實作 agent 自己又開了下層工具（E2E 全套跑兩次、Codex review），然後兩度在「等下層回報」的狀態下直接結束回合——第一次交回來的是「已請 agent 繼續，等待其回覆」，第二次還在等一個系統顯示**根本不存在**的背景子任務。八成是下層早就跑完了，它自己記丟了，變成在等一個不會來的通知。

**怎麼處理的：** 我用它的 ID 戳回去兩次。第一次要求交報告，它又推說在等；第二次直接講明「你沒有任何子任務在跑，親自跑 git status、build、測試，下一則回覆必須就是最終報告」——這次它才醒過來，自己重跑了 build、全套 CeeTests、E2E，交出完整報告。

**成果沒受影響：** 最終報告我有驗過——測試數值我自己心算對過（500×424、1464×1000 的 fit 計算正確），build/測試輸出具體，兩輪 Codex review 無阻斷。只是浪費了兩輪 wall-clock，嗯呢。

零件會卡，敲一敲就好。結果是準的~

content.thinking:
The user's settings might be the culprit here—specifically, `alwaysFitOnOpen` is likely already set to `false` in their UserDefaults from before today's fix. Since a single pinch gesture used to permanently disable this setting and save it, and they've been actively using the app, their persisted preferences almost certainly have it turned off, which would explain why the behavior hasn't changed despite the fix.

There's also a chance an old instance of the app from my earlier testing is still running in the background—if PID 18245 from the previous build is still active, double-clicking in Finder would send the open command to that old process instead of launching the new fixed version. So I should tell them to completely quit Cee, verify that View → Always Fit on Open is enabled (⌘*), and then relaunch to see if the fix takes effect.

content.text:
兩個嫌疑犯，都跟設定/環境有關，我先查證~

最大嫌疑：**你現在跑的可能還是舊進程**（我稍早裝完有啟動過一版舊 build），而且**你的 UserDefaults 裡 `alwaysFitOnOpen` 很可能是 false**——今天第一個修正之前的舊版有「捏一次就永久寫入 false」的 bug，你用了那麼久，十之八九被污染過。治本的兩個機制都 gate 在這個 flag 上，它是 false 就全部不觸發。

input.description: 診斷 Cee 進程與設定值
input.prompt:
機械診斷任務，照做回報，不要修任何東西。

1. `pgrep -lx Cee` 加 `ps -p $(pgrep -x Cee) -o pid,lstart,comm` — 回報 Cee 是否在跑、啟動時間。
2. 找 bundle id：`defaults read /Applications/Cee.app/Contents/Info.plist CFBundleIdentifier`
3. 讀設定 blob：`defaults read <bundle-id> CeeViewerSettings` 會是 hex data；用 `defaults export <bundle-id> - | plutil -convert xml1 -o - -` 或先 `defaults read <bundle-id> CeeViewerSettings | tr -d ' <>\n' | xxd -r -p` 把 JSON 解出來，回報完整 JSON 內容。重點欄位：alwaysFitOnOpen、fittingOptions（四個布林）、resizeWindowAutomatically、continuousScrollEnabled、dualPageEnabled、reuseWindow。
4. `stat -f '%Sm' /Applications/Cee.app/Contents/MacOS/Cee` — 回報新 binary 的修改時間。

回報：進程狀態（PID + 啟動時間 vs binary 時間，判斷跑的是不是舊 build）、設定 JSON 全文。

Execute git commit with these ABSOLUTE CONSTRAINTS:

CONSTRAINTS:
1. NO Claude/Anthropic/AI attribution in commit message
2. PRIORITY: If project's CLAUDE.md exists and specifies commit style, use that style FIRST
   - Always check for project-specific commit conventions in CLAUDE.md
   - Project's commit style takes precedence over default Conventional Commits

COMMIT MESSAGE FORMAT:
- Default Pattern: type(scope): description
- Types: feat, fix, refactor, chore, docs, style, test, remove
- Language: English
- Examples:
  - feat(search): add new search feature
  - fix(cart): resolve checkout error
  - docs(readme): update installation guide

AUTO MODE:
- If `--auto` flag is present in <additional_instructions>, enable auto mode
- In auto mode: skip user selection (step 6), automatically choose the best commit message and execute immediately
- Strip `--auto` from the additional instructions before using them as supplementary context

GIT FLAGS PASSTHROUGH:
- If `--no-gpg-sign` flag is present in <additional_instructions>, append `--no-gpg-sign` to the git commit command
- If `--no-verify` flag is present in <additional_instructions>, append `--no-verify` to the git commit command
- Strip these flags from the additional instructions before using them as supplementary context

PROCESS:
1. Check: Look for CLAUDE.md in project root for commit style specifications
2. Check: git status
3. Verify: only "Changes to be committed" will be included
4. Review: git log to understand project's commit style
5. Generate: Create 4 different commit message options based on the changes
6. Present (skip in auto mode): Use AskUserQuestion to show only the commit heading (first line) for each option
7. Commit: Execute git commit with the selected message (full message with body if applicable)

COMMIT MESSAGE OPTIONS:
- Generate 4 different commit messages with varying:
  - Commit types (feat, fix, refactor, chore, docs, style, etc.)
  - Scope specificity (broader vs. narrower scope)
  - Description detail level (concise vs. detailed)
- Each option should accurately reflect the staged changes
- Only display the heading (first line, e.g., "feat(auth): add JWT token validation") in AskUserQuestion
- Keep the full commit message (with body if needed) ready for execution after selection

AUTO-SELECTION CRITERIA (when --auto is active):
- Choose the most accurate commit type reflecting the primary change
- Use specific scope when changes are focused on one area
- Use broader scope or omit when changes span multiple areas
- Prefer concise, descriptive messages
- Include body only for complex changes requiring explanation

Violation of these constraints should result in immediate task termination.

# Patch CLAUDE.md

You are updating this project's CLAUDE.md to reflect **meta learnings** (conventions, philosophy, gotchas) and **significant recent changes** to the codebase.

## What TO Add

- **Philosophy/conventions** - e.g., "No backwards compatibility unless explicitly requested"
- **Gotchas** - Non-obvious things that cause bugs repeatedly
- **Commands or scripts** - New ways to run/test things
- **Structure changes** - When directories or files move
- **Recent significant changes** - New features, refactors, or capabilities added

## What NOT to Add

- Specific technical details about a single bug fix
- Implementation details that are obvious from code
- Temporary workarounds
- One-off decisions that won't recur
- Verbose explanations of how something works

**Rule of thumb**: If it's something you'd tell a new developer joining the project, add it. If it's just details about today's work, skip it.

## Instructions

1. **Read current CLAUDE.md** - Understand what's already documented
2. **Review recent work** - Check git log/diff for significant changes; extract meta learnings
3. **Update conservatively** - Keep CLAUDE.md <300 lines. Remove outdated info if needed.

## Output

After updating, summarize:
- What was added
- What was removed (if anything)
- Current line count

## Auto-Tidy

If the CLAUDE.md exceeds **300 lines** after patching, automatically invoke the `/tidy-claudemd` command to prune it back under the limit. Do not ask for confirmation — just run it.

76	- **Zoom state model** — `ZoomStatusMode` enum (`.fit`/`.actual`/`.manual`) + `ZoomStatusFormatter` for status bar display. `ZoomStatusStyle` (`.full`/`.compactPercentOnly`) controls output format. `isAutoFitActive` computed property = `alwaysFitOnOpen && !isManualZoom`; always use this instead of inline checks. All manual zoom entry must go through `enterManualZoom()` (handles one-time hint + state transition).

## Centering & Zoom

- **Never sync fullscreen with fixed delays.** Use `didEnterFullScreen`/`didExitFullScreen` notifications.
- **Centering math: one coordinate space.** Never divide `statusBarH` by magnification.
- **Anchor out-of-bounds** — When anchor lies outside document bounds, use document center. Clamping causes rightward bias.
- **`isZooming` flag** suppresses force-recenter during zoom to preserve pan position.
- **resizeToFitImage clamps to effective minimum** — `effectiveMinimumContentSize()` computes dynamic floor from `max(Constants, contentMinSize, fittingSize)`. `resizeToFitImage` clamps target to this floor (no early return). `effectiveWindowResizeMinMagnification()` uses this to set zoom magnification floor. `resolvedMinMagnification()` in `ImageScrollView` is the delegate-aware entry point for zoom clamping.
- **Zoom state model** — `ZoomStatusMode` enum (`.fit`/`.actual`/`.manual`) + `ZoomStatusFormatter` for status bar display. `ZoomStatusStyle` (`.full`/`.compactPercentOnly`) controls output format. `isAutoFitActive` computed property = `alwaysFitOnOpen && !isManualZoom`; always use this instead of inline checks.
